title: GetBaseValue - ObjectReference
content:
Member of: ObjectReference Script Gets the base value of the specified Actor Value from the Object Reference. Syntax: float Function GetBaseValue(ActorValue akAV) native Parameters: - akAV: The Actor Value to get the base value of. Actor Value List Return Value: The base value of the requested actor value. Examples: ActorValue property HealthAV ; Obtain the player's base health actor value int playersHealth = Game.GetPlayer().GetBaseValue(HealthAV)
ActorValue property HealthAV ; Obtain Bob's base health actor value int bobsHealth = Bob.GetBaseValue(HealthAV) See Also: - Actor Value List - ObjectReference Script - DamageValue - ObjectReference - GetValue - ObjectReference - ModValue - ObjectReference - RestoreValue - ObjectReference - SetValue - ObjectReference
